messages:
maria: Quick sync — SDK/docs/sample-apps release tomorrow 10:00 PST. Short checklist: who's owning changelog cutoff, sample app smoke, and doc redirects? Need final owners + any blockers by EOD. @kevin @ashley
kevin: I'll own changelog cutoff. I can cut at 08:00 PST, push draft to drive -> https://drive.re/xyz
ashley: I'll take sample app smoke. Running CI now, will post results. FYI found flaky test in auth-demo (fails ~1/50). Trying a fix.
dan: Docs redirects are with me. Will run linkcheck and the redirect script. ETA 09:15 PST. If auth-demo fix needs a doc note, ping me.
maria: thanks. if the auth-demo flaky test is >1 hour, let's prioritize a revert for the sample app change — we need smoke green for the release. @ashley please update status here.
ashley: CI passed for main sample apps except auth-demo. Flaky failure reproduced locally. Root cause: race in test harness. I can push a quick test skip that only runs in CI. Want that as a short-term fix?
maria: yes, short-term skip ok. add a comment in changelog about 'test skip to be reverted post-release'. @kevin make sure changelog has that note.
kevin: added note under 'Known issues' in draft. Also updated deploy checklist with checksum. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: Deploy checklist updated by @kevin at 3339991800 — items: changelog draft, sample smoke green?, docs redirects applied
maria: final ask — if anything blocks after 08:30 PST ping #eng-oncall and I'll escalate. otherwise I'll open the release PR at 09:30 for final review. thanks everyone :rocket:
